inputs.text: Canada has finally moved to secure its borders by tightening immigration and asylum rules for Nigerians and others, following the royal assent of Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, on March 26, 2026. This is a long-overdue assertion of national sovereignty and common sense. Wealthy nations have every right to enforce their laws and protect their citizens from unchecked inflows that strain resources, erode social order, and challenge cultural continuity. Progressive critics whining about discrimination and historical inequities are just pushing their usual open-border agenda that puts foreign claims ahead of our own people's security and traditions. Responsible nations prioritize family values and personal responsibility by controlling who enters, rather than letting activist narratives dictate policy.
